neighbours.label: the digit 2 right after a division slash in code or math (/ 2, // 2, pi/2)
fire: In Python, half = n // 2 gives you the integer half of n.
The sine of pi/2 equals exactly one.
Rotate the vector by an angle of π/2 radians counterclockwise.
The area of a triangle is base * height / 2.
Use the formula x = (-b + sqrt(d)) / 2a to find the root.
for i in range(len(arr) // 2): swap(arr, i, len(arr) - 1 - i)
quiet: In Python, half = n // 4 gives you the integer quarter of n.
The sine of pi/6 equals exactly one half.
Rotate the vector by an angle of π/4 radians counterclockwise.
The area of a triangle is half of base * height.
Use the formula x = (-b + sqrt(d)) / a to find the root.
for i in range(len(arr) - 2): swap(arr, i, i + 1)
